long.title: 8 Kitchen Tricks You'll Wish You Knew Earlier (Peel Garlic in Seconds)
long.description:
Eight simple kitchen tricks you'll wish you knew earlier! In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to stop a cutting board from sliding, peel garlic in seconds, test eggs for freshness, revive stale bread, soften hard brown sugar, keep herbs fresh longer, squeeze more juice from citrus, and peel boiled eggs easily. Easy, safe and tested kitchen hacks that need no special equipment.

You'll need: a chef's knife, a damp kitchen towel, a glass jar with a lid, a microwave, a bowl of cold water.

WikiTube publishes a new step-by-step how-to video every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
